response.query: How will vehicle and placebo controls be validated to confirm no impact on inflammation or hemostasis, and will we include single-excipient controls?
response.answer: Vehicle and placebo controls will be validated through rigorous clinical trials to ensure no impact on inflammation or hemostasis. Single-excipient controls may be included to further confirm these findings.
